blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defending champion Creamline brought out its mastery of the PVL All-Filipino Conference, ending the run of its surging sister team Choco Mucho, 21-25, 25-17, 25-17, 25-23, to advance to the Siklab Series finals on Tuesday at Philsports Arena. Despite dropping the opening set, the Cool Smashers didn’t waste their twice-to-beat advantage, vaunting their championship poise to get back at their elimination round tormentors to return to the All-Filipino finals for the 10th straight time. The 11-time PVL champion marched to its 16th finals appearance since joining the league in 2017. Choco Mucho threatened to force a decider with […]...
